mapper.sql: WITH employee_at AS ( SELECT ranked.* FROM ( SELECT version.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY version.employee_id ORDER BY version.effective_from DESC, version.created_at DESC, version.employee_version_id ) AS selected_row FROM employee_version version WHERE version.effective_from <= DATE(#{at}) AND (version.effective_to IS NULL OR version.effective_to > DATE(#{at})) ) ranked WHERE ranked.selected_row = 1 ), current_assignment AS ( SELECT ranked.* FROM ( SELECT assignment.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY assignment.employee_id ORDER BY assignment.effective_from DESC, assignment.assignment_id ) AS assignment_row_number FROM employment_assignment assignment WHERE assignment.effective_from <= #{at} AND (assignment.effective_to IS NULL OR assignment.effective_to > #{at}) AND assignment.version_valid_to IS NULL AND assignment.record_status = 'ACTIVE' ) ranked WHERE ranked.assignment_row_number = 1 )

EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM auth_principal principal JOIN auth_principal_role_assignment role_assignment ON role_assignment.principal_id = principal.principal_id JOIN auth_role_capability role_capability ON role_capability.role_id = role_assignment.role_id JOIN auth_capability capability ON capability.capability_id = role_capability.capability_id AND capability.capability_code = #{capabilityCode} JOIN auth_data_scope data_scope ON data_scope.scope_id = role_assignment.data_scope_id WHERE principal.principal_id = #{principalId} AND principal.status = 'ACTIVE' AND role_assignment.valid_from <= #{at} AND (role_assignment.valid_to IS NULL OR role_assignment.valid_to > #{at}) AND data_scope.valid_from <= #{at} AND (data_scope.valid_to IS NULL OR data_scope.valid_to > #{at}) AND ( (data_scope.scope_type = 'COMPANY' AND data_scope.company_id = employee.company_id) OR (data_scope.scope_type = 'ORGANIZATION' AND current_assignment.organization_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM organization_identity scoped_organization JOIN organization_identity assigned_organization ON assigned_organization.organization_id = current_assignment.organization_id AND assigned_organization.company_id = scoped_organization.company_id WHERE scoped_organization.organization_id = data_scope.organization_id AND scoped_organization.company_id = employee.company_id ) AND ( current_assignment.organization_id = data_scope.organization_id OR (data_scope.include_descendants = TRUE AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM organization_current_closure closure WHERE closure.ancestor_organization_id = data_scope.organization_id AND closure.descendant_organization_id = current_assignment.organization_id )) )) ) )

sql.if: AND ( LOWER(employee_at.employee_number) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{query}), '%') OR LOWER(employee_at.display_name) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{query}), '%') )

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employee employee JOIN employee_at ON employee_at.employee_id = employee.employee_id LEFT JOIN current_assignment ON current_assignment.employee_id = employee.employee_id WHERE

SELECT employee.employee_id, employee_at.employee_version_id, employee_at.employee_number, employee_at.display_name, employee_at.status AS employment_status, current_assignment.organization_id, organization_version.name AS organization_name, organization_version.code AS organization_code, source_binding.seeyon_oa_code, source_binding.binding_status, current_assignment.effective_from AS assignment_effective_from, current_assignment.effective_to AS assignment_effective_to, employee_at.source_authority, employee.row_version FROM employee employee JOIN employee_at ON employee_at.employee_id = employee.employee_id LEFT JOIN current_assignment ON current_assignment.employee_id = employee.employee_id LEFT JOIN organization_current_projection projection ON projection.organization_id = current_assignment.organization_id LEFT JOIN organization_version organization_version ON organization_version.organization_version_id = projection.current_version_id LEFT JOIN employee_source_binding source_binding ON source_binding.employee_id = employee.employee_id AND source_binding.effective_to IS NULL WHERE
ORDER BY
employee_at.employee_number
employee_at.status
organization_version.name
employee.updated_at
employee_at.display_name
, employee.employee_id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
